lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You come back with the mail. What happens?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well I stopped and I seen if there was any mail for me so and I seen Steven's so I went over there right away ta bring it over by 'em and I knocked like three times and then he finally came.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Are you hearing anything coming from the other side of the trailer at this time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The words, help me.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. That's gotta be pretty devastating, right? (Brendan nods “yes”) But you still knock.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: mm huh.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You went into the trailer then? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You knock and he comes to the door. What's he look like? Is he dressed, has he got anything on him, what-what's he look like?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He's got a white shirt on with red shorts and all sweaty.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He's all sweaty. (Brendan nods “yes”) Any blood, at this time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) No.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Does he let you in the trailer?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He asks me in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He walks me into the kitchen.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What does he say to you?
